children: Daren Swenson, an officer serving as EVP, Chief Corr & Reentry Ofcr, sold 20,000 shares of CoreCivic common stock at $34.85 per share on September 11, 2026. The total sale amount was $697,000. Following the transaction, Swenson directly owned 142,666 shares and indirectly owned 4,625 shares held by a spouse. The reporting person disclaims beneficial ownership of the indirectly held shares.
